adrenaline_rush: Gain energy and draw two cards: paired rising wisps separate toward the hand; retain real draw animations. No outgoing projectile.
arcane_bolt: Six-damage ranged hit: pointed ivory/cyan illustrated energy body, immediate release, 75–260 ms accelerating travel, short actual-motion wake and painted impact plus sparks.
arcane_blast: Ten-damage single-target missile: larger projectile body and broad asymmetric pressure burst at arrival; distinguish its heavier recoil from Bolt.
arcane_explosion: Only surrounding enemies take damage: flattened expanding pressure front and counter-facing recoil crescent on actual affected targets, without marking extra tiles.
arcane_flame: Damage plus Burn: ascending painted flame crown at the victim with ivory inner planes and warm outer tongues. Existing Burn status feedback remains.
chrono_jab: Two real hits 0.3 seconds apart, then Weakened: compact horizontal cut with a displaced temporal afterimage. Each real hit owns its own effect; visual layers do not schedule damage.
corroding_shot: Single-target damage plus two Corroded: compact plum/olive wet stain with a separate falling droplet layer. This implementation is a direct application, not a traveling missile.
corrosion_wave: Damage and Corroded on all actual enemies: a wider, flattened spreading capillary stain on each receiver. No invented persistent area hazard.
deminishing_returns: Adjacent strike scales with living enemy count: narrow hooked vertical cut; retain the count/damage implementation.
echo: Recalls the previous discard as a zero-cost exhausted copy: spectral thumbnail reads the actual previous card artwork, rises and fades above the caster alongside a folded wisp. No damage burst.
echo_harvest: Gather the actual finite deposit: retain the established directional resource-gather feedback and real deposit-to-depleted terrain change.
eldritch_barrier: Ten block: one large upright illustrated shield assembles around the recipient at 42% opacity, preserving visibility of the player through it; preserve real block consumer and UI response.
focus: Gain Attunement: a single energy wisp compresses and rises toward the recipient's head, rather than exploding outward.
fracture_pulse: All-enemy damage plus energy: crossing ground-oriented cuts extend under actual receivers; energy uses the existing player-targeted effect.
jab: Two adjacent physical hits: small sharp asymmetric impacts at each real hit, short dissipation and existing hit reaction, no traveling spell.
mana_leech: Weaken the target and gain energy: small inward collapse on the victim and staggered stolen-mana wisps travel to the actual player ImpactAnchor. Transfer is cosmetic; no extra effect waits.
mana_surge: Temporary energy: a tall rising energy body lifts from the recipient toward the chest; existing energy value and HUD pulse stay authoritative.
nano_shield: Six block plus energy: three translucent illustrated plates (40% opacity) assemble separately around the recipient, followed by the separately configured Mana Surge. Deliberately distinct from one large Eldritch shield.
overload_shot: Spend all current energy for a ranged hit: jagged thick violet discharge with bright core, then a tall asymmetric painted blast. Preserve energy-cost calculation.
phase_slash: Direct target slash with movement-conditioned armor bypass: broad diagonal painted crescent, dark underside and sweeping recoil; preserve the existing conditional second application.
phase_step: Move through legal adjacent tiles: the actual player illustration phases to 4% of its starting opacity in 45ms, holds through mid-step, and phases back in at the destination by 200ms. Two world-space snapshots of the real illustration dissolve behind the actual movement. Cancellation restores original opacity; board, collision and movement timing remain authoritative. No floor slash.
quantum_rift: Move to an explored tile: a standing vertical tear opens using reversed illustrated frames, then a separate narrow tear closes. No projectile, area damage or altered movement mechanics.
rift_knowledge: Apply Attuned: three staggered small wisps converge upward around the recipient; concise application with existing restrained status icon.
sever_anchor: Ranged strike with Obelisk bonus: split ochre tether and steep severing cut, followed by a shrinking dark anchor-remnant. Keep bonus formula/message unchanged.
void_fracture: Creates three Void Shard cards: small opening at the caster releases three individually authored shard silhouettes in a fan. Existing card spotlight animations remain the actual creation feedback.
void_shard: Six-damage Void missile: retain pointed plum projectile art with fast actual flight and plum wake; small angled implosion on arrival.
void_surge: Missing-health damage to one enemy: tall torn inward mouth with a crossing blood-echo cut; preserve missing-health calculation, no projectile or invented area.
mend: Actual enemy healing: paired rising illustrated energy/leaf strokes, muted cool tint, finite lifetime. Does not replace damage or ward imagery.
arcane_hit: Ordinary projectile contact: short painted cyan recoil burst with bounded directional sparks at the actual impact anchor.
arcane_release: Compact short cyan casting release at SpellOrigin, separate from travel body and target impact.
void_release: Compact short plum opening at SpellOrigin, separate from Void projectile travel and impact.
